1970.notes: ACIR Significant Features of Fiscal Federalism 1970-71 ed. (M-57), Table 43 note (p. 102, rates at December 31, 1970): Denver Employee Occupational Privilege Tax of $2 per employee per month, applying only to employees earning at least $250 per month. The only later amendment of sec. 53-241, Ord. 775-07 sec. 137 (December 2007, one of secs. 135-160 of that ordinance), is read as the 2007 renaming of the manager of revenue as manager of finance, and Ord. 34-12 sec. 23 (2012) amended sec. 53-240 with the $500 unchanged in the 2020 text; neither ordinance was read. Year-specific documents not located.
